empty.heading: No sessions found
empty.body: Beekeeper found no Claude Code sessions under ~/.claude/projects (or the projects folder under CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR when it's set). Sessions appear here after you run Claude Code in a project.

unreadable.heading: Can't read your sessions
unreadable.body: Beekeeper can't read ~/.claude/projects (or the projects folder under CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR when it's set). Check that folder's permissions. On macOS, also check whether beekeeper was denied access to it. Then retry.

folderGone.showing: The folder {{folder}} no longer exists. Showing {{project}}.
